# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in Alpine Workstation.

## Validation

- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Documentation matches the command-line behavior.
- [ ] Disk, authentication, PAM, firewall, and boot changes were tested in a disposable guest when applicable.
- [ ] No secret, private key, password, machine-specific path, or personal configuration is included.
